heading: Combined T_wcet under `linear_scan: false`, default TTL
text:
### Combined T_wcet under `linear_scan: false`, default TTL [LDTL.7.4]

```
T_wcet(linear_scan=false, dynamic_ttl=false) =
    c_alpha × Σ_s(α_s × T_s)                 ← DSC constants
  + c_join  × F_max                           ← O(1) per firing, F_max = DSC constant
  + c_agenda × F_max                          ← O(1) 3-bucket queue
  + c_fire  × F_max × A_max × E_rhs          ← DSC constants
  + c_ttl   × (max_expired_per_tick × log n_ttl_schemas
               + n_ttl_schemas)               ← derived constant
```

**All parameters are compile-time constants.**  T_wcet is a single
fixed number determined by the DSC, N_max, and tick_interval.  There
are no log factors in N_max or N_ttl (the TTL term's is in
`n_ttl_schemas`, fixed at load, [LDTL.6.1]), no N_max-growth terms, and
no remaining variables.
This is the theoretical floor for a Rete engine with expression
evaluation — the only remaining non-constant factor is E_rhs, the RHS
expression depth, which is eliminated only by AoT specialization.
